text:
The ERC failure comes from tying the NMOS pair bulks to their sources, which this substrate doesn't allow. The fix moves both bulks to vss and sizes M1/M2 with the real source-bulk voltage (vsb ≈ Veb). With body effect, node g1 now sits higher. To keep M4 saturated at -40 °C, the NMOS pair moves deeper into weak inversion (higher gm/Id) and the PMOS mirror stays long-L.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "ERC: nfet bulks must be vss. Tie M1/M2 bulk to vss and size with vsb=Veb; push NMOS pair deeper into weak inversion to offset body-effect Vgs rise and keep M4 Vsd headroom at cold; add a headroom check to the predictions."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I0":     (4e-6, 2e-6, 10e-6),    # PTAT branch current
    "r21":    (9.4, 7.0, 12.0),       # R2/R1 (sets TC / vref)
    "gmid_p": (9, 6, 13),             # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Lp":     (3.0, 1.5, 4.0),        # PMOS mirror L (line regulation)
    "gmid_n": (22, 14, 25),           # NMOS pair gm/Id (deep weak inv -> low Vgs despite body effect)
    "Ln":     (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "Ifol":   (3e-6, 1.5e-6, 8e-6),   # follower bias current
    "Vcas":   (0.25, 0.15, 0.35),     # pb - pc
    "Cc":     (5e-12, 1e-12, 15e-12), # dominant-pole cap on node d
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    m3 = 2
    VDD = 1.8
    T = 300.15
    I0 = p["I0"]
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I0
    R2 = p["r21"] * R1

    # PMOS mirror devices (long L for high ro)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I0, vds=0.4)
    pb = VDD - mp.vgs
    mpc = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I0, vds=0.35)

    # NMOS common-gate pair: bulk on vss (p-substrate) -> vsb = Veb
    veb = 0.76 + UT * math.log(I0 / 10e-6)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I0, vds=0.5, vsb=veb)
    g1 = veb + mn.vgs

    # Source follower level shift d -> pb
    mf = lut.size("n", 15, 1.0, p["Ifol"], vds=VDD - pb, vsb=pb)
    Rtot = pb / p["Ifol"]
    Ra = p["Vcas"] / p["Ifol"]
    Rb = max(Rtot - Ra, 1e3)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PNP core
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "q2", m=N)
    n.R("R1", "e2", "q2", R1)
    # NMOS common-gate pair, bulk = vss
    n.dev("M1", "g1", "g1", "e1", "vss", mn)   # diode
    n.dev("M2", "d", "g1", "e2", "vss", mn)
    # PMOS mirror
    n.dev("M4", "g1", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M3", "d", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # follower level shift: pb = d - Vgs(MF)
    n.dev("MF", "vdd", "d", "pb", "vss", mf)
    n.R("RA", "pb", "pc", Ra)
    n.R("RB", "pc", "vss", Rb)
    n.C("CC", "d", "vdd", p["Cc"])
    # output branch (cascoded)
    n.dev("M5", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M5C", "vref", "pc", "x", "x", mpc)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=m3)
    # start-up: vref low -> s high -> pull pb low
    n.M("MSP", "s", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSK", "s", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MST", "pb", "s", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 0.5)

    # ---------- predictions ----------
    veb3 = 0.76 + UT * math.log(I0 / 10e-6) - UT * math.log(m3)
    VR2 = R2 * I0
    vref = veb3 + VR2
    dvbe = (veb3 - 1.17 - 3 * UT) / T
    dvref = dvbe + VR2 / T
    tc = abs(dvref) / vref * 1e6 + 8.0
    # M4 headroom (27C); cold adds ~0.12 V Veb + ~0.05 V Vth
    m4_vsd = VDD - g1
    gds_id = mp.gm_id / mp.intrinsic_gain
    k5 = Ra / Rtot
    line_reg = VR2 * gds_id * (1.0 / math.log(N) + k5) + 0.5e-3
    if m4_vsd < 0.3:
        line_reg += 5e-3 * (0.3 - m4_vsd) / 0.1
        tc += 10.0 * (0.3 - m4_vsd) / 0.1
    i_tot = 3 * I0 + p["Ifol"] + 0.5e-6
    power = VDD * i_tot
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "power": power, "startup_ok": 1}
```
